description: Fixed pyperformance JIT28 comparison contract. Scripts must fail closed when the contract, suite lock, environment, or result schema does not match.
invalid_if: suite manifest hash does not match suite lock
benchmark_filter does not match suite selectors
sample count is not 12 for every resolved case
base and candidate summaries do not use this contract_id
base and candidate summaries do not use this suite_manifest_sha256
any resolved case is missing or any extra case appears
pyperformance parent process is run with ad hoc JIT environment outside the contract runner
cinderx import path does not come from the variant workdir
pyperformance worker does not load the runner sitecustomize hook
pyperformance worker cannot import _cinderx with the variant runtime library path
pyperformance worker is not cinderx-initialized or JIT-enabled before benchmark execution
pyperformance worker JIT compile-after threshold is not 50
LD_LIBRARY_PATH required by the built wheel is not inherited by workers
